title: Analysis of lipid droplets in mature 3T3-L1 adipocytes using oil red O
author: Kaczmarek, Suchý, et al.

steps.title: Prepare and seed 3T3‑L1 cells
steps.instruction: Under sterile conditions, aspirate old media, wash cells with 5 mL Ca²⁺/Mg²⁺‑free PBS, discard PBS, add 2 mL 0.25 % Trypsin/EDTA, incubate 1–2 min at 37 °C/5 % CO₂, tap to loosen cells, add 8 mL culture medium to stop trypsinisation, centrifuge 5 min at 200 RCF, discard supernatant, resuspend in 2 mL medium, count cells with a Neubauer chamber, dilute to 2.5 × 10⁵ cells/flask for a 48 h culture or 1.25 × 10⁵ cells/flask for a 72 h culture in 20 mL medium, evenly distribute by moving the flask, and incubate 2–3 days at 37 °C/5 % CO₂.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate old media.
Add 5 mL Ca²⁺/Mg²⁺‑free PBS, gently shake, discard PBS.
Add 2 mL 0.25 % Trypsin/EDTA; incubate 1–2 min at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.
Tap bottle to loosen cells, add 8 mL culture medium to stop trypsinisation.
Centrifuge suspension 5 min at 200 RCF; discard supernatant.
Resuspend pellet in 2 mL culture medium.
Count cells using a Neubauer chamber.
Dilute cells in 20 mL medium to reach the desired seeding density (2.5 × 10⁵ or 1.25 × 10⁵ cells/flask).
Evenly distribute cells by moving the flask.
Incubate 2–3 days at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Fix adipocytes with formalin
steps.instruction: Discard culture medium, add 250 µL 10 % (v/v) formalin in PBS to each well, incubate 5 min at room temperature (RT), replace with fresh formalin, incubate 1 h at RT. Optional: replace formalin with water, wrap plate with parafilm and store up to 4 weeks at 4 °C in the dark.

substeps.instruction: Discard media.
Add 250 µL 10 % formalin (v/v) in PBS.
Incubate 5 min at RT.
Renew formalin (replace with fresh solution).
Incubate 1 h at RT.
Optional storage: substitute formalin with water, wrap with parafilm, store ≤4 weeks at 4 °C in dark.

steps.title: Stain cells with Oil Red O
steps.instruction: Discard formalin, wash cells with 250 µL 60 % (v/v) isopropanol (tap plate on paper towels to remove excess), let cells dry, add 150 µL Oil Red O working solution per well, incubate 10 min at RT, discard solution, wash five times with running distilled water (hold plate at a slight angle to avoid direct flow), then cover with 250 µL distilled water.

substeps.instruction: Discard formalin.
Wash with 250 µL 60 % isopropanol; tap plate on paper towels.
Let cells dry.
Add 150 µL Oil Red O working solution.
Incubate 10 min at RT.
Discard Oil Red O solution.
Wash 5× with running distilled water, holding plate at a slight angle.
Cover cells with 250 µL distilled water.

steps.title: Capture bright‑field images
steps.instruction: Using a bright‑field microscope, acquire three random pictures per well (total nine pictures per treatment for three technical replicates), ensuring high contrast, avoiding over‑focus, and confirming that lipid droplets appear round.

steps.title: Analyze lipid droplets in ImageJ
steps.instruction: Save the provided macro code in ImageJ, adjust the scale line (e.g., distance=1920 known=1440 unit=µm) to match the image’s pixel‑to‑µm conversion, then run the macro to convert the image to HSB stack, apply color thresholds (Hue 0‑255, Saturation 132‑255, Brightness 70‑255), perform watershed separation, and obtain measurements of droplet number, size, and distribution.

substeps.instruction: Save the macro code (including Set Scale, Color Threshold, HSB conversion, thresholds, and watershed loop) as an ImageJ macro.
Open a microscopic picture, note the pixel‑to‑µm values (upper‑left corner), and edit the macro’s Set Scale line accordingly.
Run the macro; it will binarize, separate overlapping droplets, and generate a drawing for manual verification.
Review the output tables for droplet count and size.

steps.title: Elute Oil Red O for quantification
steps.instruction: Discard the distilled water, let cells dry, add 150 µL 100 % (v/v) isopropanol per well, incubate 10 min at RT, pipette up and down, transfer 140 µL eluate to a fresh flat‑bottom 96‑well plate, and measure absorbance at 500 nm, correcting with the reading at 620 nm.

substeps.instruction: Discard water.
Let cells dry.
Add 150 µL 100 % isopropanol per well.
Incubate 10 min at RT.
Pipette solution up and down.
Transfer 140 µL eluate to a fresh 96‑well plate.
Measure OD at 500 nm and correct with OD at 620 nm.

steps.title: Quantify and statistically analyze data
steps.instruction: For each treatment, record lipid droplet counts and calculate percentages relative to control; compute average droplet size and compare using paired Student’s t test; bin droplets into size groups (0–120 µm², 120–240 µm², >240 µm²) and calculate group percentages, testing significance with two‑way ANOVA when appropriate; for eluted Oil Red O, calculate percentage versus control and assess differences with paired Student’s t test.

substeps.instruction: Take droplet count per treatment; optionally express as % of control.
Perform paired Student’s t test for droplet count comparisons.
Record individual droplet sizes; calculate mean size per treatment.
Test mean size differences with paired Student’s t test.
Sort droplets into size bins (0–120, 120–240, >240 µm²).
Calculate % of droplets in each bin; compare using two‑way ANOVA for multiple groups.
Calculate % eluted Oil Red O relative to control.
Assess ORO differences with paired Student’s t test.
